positive_global_styles: Entirely instrumental cinematic deep-space film score, no human voices
Expressive real cathedral pipe organ, felt piano, resonant bass pedals, orchestral strings and restrained analog synthesizers
Original memorable melodic motif with spacious intervals and repeating arpeggios, intimate wonder growing into cosmic dread
D minor tonal center, wide stereo concert-hall reverberation, detailed professional orchestral recording
One coherent evolving composition with continuous transitions between four dramatic scenes
Audible instrumental performance from the very first second; full-band recording with no silent lead-in, no count-in and no extended fade-in
Natural acoustic instrumental timbres, crisp transients, no time-stretch warble, no granular effects

positive_local_styles: Start on an audible felt-piano and pipe-organ downbeat at time zero, with a clear original melodic motif immediately. No quiet prelude or silent introduction.
Measured 68 BPM, gentle ticking pulse underneath, spacious and searching rather than cheerful
Gradually introduce low strings and richer organ registers; restrained crescendo toward the end
Maintain a clearly memorable original motif and breathing room; unease grows in the last twenty seconds
At the section boundary make an unmistakable shift to a darker, grave, serious mood
Heavy half-time feel around 52 BPM, deep organ pedals, low bowed strings, shadowed minor harmony with a flat-second tension
Withdraw the bright piano; state the same melodic idea slowly in a lower organ register
Quiet dread and immense weight, no triumphant resolution, sustained low resonance
Build to 92 BPM with an urgent repeating organ ostinato and restless low string pulses
Darker variation of the original motif, increasingly dissonant suspensions and rising string lines
Growing mechanical inevitability, powerful organ layers and deep restrained orchestral percussion
Serious escalating tension, no heroic or victorious feeling

sections.section_name: Final moments: overwhelming gravity and release
positive_local_styles: 112 BPM, concentrated urgent pulses and towering low pipe organ, trembling strings, maximum harmonic tension
Brief powerful climax without clipping; sustain a dark unresolved chord
In the final four seconds let the rhythmic motion fall away into a long, haunting organ reverberation
